condition: In the Next.js app router, calling dayjs.extend and dayjs.tz.setDefault in a module imported only from layout.tsx doesn't carry over to client components that import 'dayjs' directly, because they are built into separate bundles.
workaround: Don't import 'dayjs' directly in components. Import your own configured module (e.g. '@/src/common/utils/dayjs') that calls extend/locale/setDefault and re-exports dayjs.
